notes.title: Tokyo Game Show 2025: Preview full release content early!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!



Thank you as always for supporting Aeruta!



We’re excited to announce that Aeruta will be exhibited at Tokyo Game Show 2025, held at Makuhari Messe starting Thursday, September 25th!

You’ll be able to experience a brand-new island ahead of release and also receive exclusive original novelties available only at the venue. Don’t miss the chance to visit our booth!


[hr][/hr]◇ Experience upcoming full-release content in advance!
At this event, you’ll get the chance to play part of the additional content planned for the official release—before anyone else!



Embark on an adventure on the “Third Island,” where you’ll pursue the fate of the Aeruta Crystal, develop new bread recipes using fresh ingredients, and raise your own Patti Ranch by recruiting and nurturing Pattis. Packed with exciting new content, this is the perfect opportunity to preview what’s coming in the full version!



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43525165/b6827795d7a903e49b3d17a2e6ed7c62b2aac3b4.png"]

Please note: Game content shown at the event may differ from the specifications in the official release.
This demo includes content previously available in the “Steam Playtest” that began on September 5.
[hr][/hr]【Tokyo Game Show 2025 Overview】
Event Dates

Business Days: September 25 (Thu) – September 26 (Fri), 10:00 – 17:00

Public Days: September 27 (Sat), 9:30 – 17:00 / September 28 (Sun), 9:30 – 16:30



Official TGS Website

https://tgs.cesa.or.jp/jp



Aeruta Booth
Hall 11-C11 (Gravity Game Arise Booth)


◇ Exclusive venue novelties!
Players who try out Aeruta at the venue will receive an original hand towel.
This novelty is only available at TGS, so be sure to take it home as a memento of your visit!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43525165/c85fe8412a9e630445d59bfeeb6ff3d9c36071b7.png"]


◇ Special TGS Exhibition Sale!
To celebrate our appearance at Tokyo Game Show 2025, we’re holding a special sale!

During the event period, you can purchase Aeruta for 10% OFF at 1,260 yen. Don’t miss out on this limited-time offer!



Sale Period
September 18 (Thu), 3:00 AM – September 29 (Mon), 3:00 AM (PDT)



Sale Price 

$14.99 → $13.49 (10% OFF)
[hr][/hr]


We’re truly looking forward to meeting you all at the venue!
Thank you again for your continued support of Aeruta!

notes.title: Aeruta Early Access Ver.0.2.2 Update!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! 
This is the FromDawn Games team🔆

Thank you so much for your continued support of Aeruta in Early Access!

This month, we will be releasing a small update that introduces some new systems and adjustments to enhance the overall gameplay experience and help players further immerse themselves in the world.

The details of the update are as follows:

2025/03/13 EA Version 0.2.2 Patch Notes
Content Additions & System Adjustments

 New friendship stories for two Goddess characters
Like other characters, their friendship level can now be raised up to Level 4.
The Goddesses will randomly appear in town, and as their friendship increases, 
they will visit more often.

Once their friendship is high enough, they can also assist in the bakery, providing unique benefits.

 Wave spawn condition adjustments in adventure stages
Changed from "Defeat all monsters" to "Defeat all non-Patti monsters".
 Trap adjustments in the second island's adventure stages

Modified trap placements to improve combat flow and reduce interruptions.

Bug Fixes

 Fixed an issue where the game could freeze during battle results.


Once again, we sincerely appreciate your ongoing support!

Even after this small update, we will continue refining the game based on player feedback while working hard on upcoming content to make Aeruta even better!

We'd love to hear your thoughts after playing, so please feel free to share your feedback on social media or through our community channels!
We're looking forward to your thoughts!

Thank you for your continued support of Aeruta.

notes.title: Aeruta Early Access Ver.0.2.1 Update!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

Thank you for playing the Early Access version of Aeruta.
Today at 18:00 (JST) the game has been updated to the latest version.

The contents of the update are as follows:

■12/17/2024Ver.0.2.1 Patch Note
Additions

 A record player has been added to the second floor of the bakery. Rhythm games can be re-played here.
  A new song “Merca Forest” was added to the rhythm game.
 Ten new stages have been added to the second island.
 When selecting a map, the number of materials available in that map are now displayed.
 When developing the village or renovating the bakery, the effect of the next level is now displayed.
 Bakery helpers now clean up trash. (So helpful!)
 A button to cancel checkout is now displayed when you're running the bakery.

Balance Adjustments

 The effect of the village facility “streetlight” has been enhanced. It further improves the patience of customers.
 Each facility in the village that increases the number of customer visits has been modified to also increase the maximum waiting line for checkout.
 Changed the quantity of gifts required when raising the likelihood of a fellow member to raise NPC friendship levels.
 The effect of the additional ability of the rolling pin, “Passive Chaos,” was changed so that it is activated one second after the dough reaches the maximum limit.
 The additional ability “Secondary Target”  speed at which the rolling pin flies toward the enemy has been slowed.
 Changed the size of the skill “Rolling Pin Cyclone” so that when the “Enticing Aroma ” additional ability is used it attracts even more enemies
 The limit for accumulating dough for the drive skill when attacking multiple monsters with the “Rolling Pin Cyclone” skill has been changed to 10 doughs.
 The whip skill “Spiral Leap” has been changed so that it can attack downward even if you have not learned the additional ability “Blossom Whirl” (so strong!)
 The cooldown time reduction effect of the badge “Stabby Crab's Instinctive Dodge” has been fixed at 3.5 seconds.
 The damage reduction rate for the badge “Summer Clam's Sudden Insight” has been changed from 3% to 2.5% and the maximum reduction rate from 75% to 50%.
 The number of times thorn balls can be reflected with the badge “Shooty Crab's Rolling Spikes” has been changed to unlimited, and the maximum number of hits to the same target has been adjusted from one to three to reduce the speed.
 A cooldown (3 seconds) has been added to the HP recovery effect of the badge “Bonkfish's Sonic Wave.”
 The effect of the badge “Ponkfish's Inspiration” has been changed so that the shield is no longer earned when a patti tribe is defeated.
 In the main quest “Save Tyreenss,” the quantity of each material required for progress has been changed.
 Wood: From 5 pieces to 50 pieces.
 Ponkfruit: From 3 pieces to 10 pieces.
 Patti dough: From 100 pieces to 300 pieces.

Bug Fixes

 Fixed an issue that prevented some monsters from attacking Chaya in certain circumstances.
 Fixed an issue where the gift would disappear if the screen was quickly closed when a gift was given.
 Fixed a problem in which the position of the “Chilala's Genius Lab” was incorrect when the building was completed.
 Fixed a problem in which the effect of the badge “Stabby Crab's Sideways Movement” was not activating correctly.
 Fixed an issue where the damage of the badge “Shooty Crab's Rolling Spikes” was higher than expected.
 Fixed an issue where after the boss “Patti King” splits in two, if the left side “King Patty” was knocked down during the fall, the right side “Patti King” would not move.


Aeruta will continue to improve and modify existing content and tweak new content based on your comments.
We look forward to all your honest feedback.

Thank you for your continued support of Aeruta.

notes.title: Aeruta Early Access Ver.0.2.0 f1 Update!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

Thank you for always supporting Aeruta.
We'd like to extend a special thank you to everyone who immediately played the major update that launched last week.

This particular update focuses on bug fixes and balance adjustments for the newly added content, as well as improving some existing content.

Read below for the details.

■11/26/2024　Ver.0.2.0 f1 Patch Note
New Additions

 Daily Bonus labels are now also displayed on the Bread Research screen.
 If a new conversation is available on the character conversation screen, a "?" mark will be displayed. If a conversation that would increase the character's friendship points is available a "!" will be displayed.
 Adjusted Chilala's position as long as "Chilala's Genius Lab" has not been constructed.
 Added a label of the game version being played to the upper right corner of the screen.

Balance Adjustments

 The amount of HP recovery from consuming Snowman Dumplings has been adjusted from 100% to 75%
 The effects of Blossom Mochi has been changed to "HP is decreased by 4.5% every 10 seconds and converted into a 6% shield."
 Selling price of bread at closing time has been changed from 50% to 75%.
 The number of regular materials required for badge production was changed from 30 to 20.
 The Baker Popularity level required to unlock Floral Maze was changed from 100 to 175.
 The Baker Popularity level required to unlock Iris Fortress was changed from 175 to 250.
 Increased the HP of Floral Emissary Visser by 10% and changed the attack pattern when she reaches low HP.
 Increased the HP of Blazing Flower Goddess Tyreenss by 7% and increased some of her attack damage.
 The number of customers visiting during bakery operations was adjusted. The overall number of customer visits now increases relative to the number of loaves of bread being sold.
 Adjusted the effect of the rolling pin's additional skill "Passive Chaos" so that it only activates when there is an enemy on the screen and will not target the air.

Bug Fixes

 Fixed a bug where Effie's Gloves would not function properly.
 Fixed a problem with the upgraded Lv2 Inn not displaying properly.
 Fixed a problem with text not being displayed on the lower right enhancement button of the Skill Tree.
 Fixed an error where a helper was not displayed correctly when selecting a helper for bakery management.
 Fixed a problem that caused some items to drop in abnormally large quantities when using the Bread Energy "Harvest Prayer."
 Fixed an issue with incorrect drop probability of bread appearing with the "Not Alone" skill in the Skill Tree.
 Fixed an issue with the badge "Stabby Crab's Sideways Movement" not activating correctly.
 Fixed an issue in which the attack of the spotted garden eels would not play in Merca Temple.
 Fixed an occasional lag when text is displayed at the top of the screen.
 When using a controller, only certain buttons could be used to advance dialog after giving a gift.
 Fixed a problem in which some number values were not displayed correctly in languages that use "," as decimal points.
 Fixed some translation, UI, and other issues.

Last but not least, we hope you will continue to provide us your valuable feedback to help make Aeruta an even better game! 

We appreciate all your continued support of Aeruta!

notes.title: Free Fall Major Update, available from today
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43525165/ca1de048a884b3dac2a85620ff4f28f33eee10ba.jpg
Hello everyone!

Thank you for your continued support of “Aeruta”.
As we've been teasing for the past weeks, the free Fall Major Update has been added as of today!

This update features a new adventure in new stages, the “Second Island.”
Additionally, we have added various elements such as encounters with new powerful enemies, 
new systems to help your adventures, and even more unique breads.

Whether you have played before or want to play in the future, we hope you will enjoy the world of Aeruta, which we are always working hard to improve!

Besides the new content, we are also improving the specifications and adjusting the balance of existing content.

Please see below for more details.

■11/21/2024 Patch Note
New Content

 New area “Second Island”: new map, new monsters, new bosses, new ingredients, new bread, etc.
 Badge system: A new system has been added that allows players to customize their play style by equipping badges.
 Friendship system: We have added a system that allows you to bond with characters and learn more about their stories.
 Character behavior system: characters now appear randomly on the adventure map.
 Calendar system: A system that has different effects depending on the calendar date in-game.
 Mini-games: Additional mini-games that can be enjoyed during the main storyline.
 Additions to the skill ability system: A new system has been added that allows for additional abilities to be added to weapons.

Balance Adjustments

 Adjusted the speed of scene changes.
 Adjusted the consumption of coins and resources when performing Bread Research.
 Coin consumption when changing additional abilities in the skill tree has been eliminated. *Instead, coins are required to reset skill levels.
 Added the option to automatically launch a series of attacks by holding down the attack key.
 Added an option to display a notification when a skill's cool time ends. (Very useful!)
 Fine-tuned the placement of the water column and the score position in the Watersong Festival mini-game.
 Cleaning up trash during bakery operations was adjusted to delight nearby customers and increase wait times at the cash register.
 Adjusted the experience required to level up bread made with boss materials.
 Adjusted the material consumption of some breads to be less.

Adventure-Related Additions/Adjustments

 A treasure chest stage has been added, where gifts for friends and ingredients can be obtained.
 A "Patti Defense Battle" stage has been added that rewards you a large amount of patti dough when cleared.
 Adjusted the timing to display the results screen when Chaya faints.
 The number of attacks required to destroy objects in the stages has been reduced to one hit. (Time-saver!)
 Adjusted the required level to use take-out bread on adventures to be lower.
 Adjusted the amount of wood obtained to be higher.
 Adjusted resources obtained from boss battles to be higher!

Combat-Related Adjustments

 Adjusted the balancing for various skills of both the whip and rolling pin.
 Adjusted the HP and attack power of boss Rock Golem to be slightly easier.
 Adjusted Kocori's post-nap ferocity by reducing the attack power and hit points of certain attacks.
 Adjusted the hit detection border for the water pillars.
 Adjusted speed when getting off platforms.
 When using Bread Energy to revive, one additional loaf of bread is replenished.
 Adjusted base crit rate and critical damage.

UI Changes

 Materials not yet acquired on the adventure preparation screen are now indicated with a grayed out "?"
 Added coin icons onto the Training screen.
 Added a numerical display of Chaya's HP.
 Adjusted the way buffs are displayed. Important ones are now displayed above Chaya's head, while others are displayed below the HP bar.
 Improved calendar display: days of the week added. Days Monday to Saturday are shown, but not Sunday.
 Adjusted audio sound effects of obstacles: it should not play when moving between stages.
 Audio of off-screen traps has been made less choppy.
 Improved visibility of high rarity materials.


Bug Fixes

 Fixed a bug that caused villagers to take off their hats when going out.
 Fixed interaction bugs.
 Fixed a bug that unintentionally increased the damage of certain skills.
 Many other minor bugs were fixed!


Fall Major Update Sale! Save a whopping 20% off!
To celebrate the big update, a sale will be held until Wednesday, December 4th.
Don't miss this opportunity to save 20% off the regular Early Access price!

◆Duration
Wed. Nov. 20th 10:00AM ～ Wed. Dec. 4th 10:00AM (PST)

◆Sale Price
$11.99


We'd like to give a big THANK YOU to everyone for always supporting Aeruta.
The whole team is very happy to be able to offer you all new expansions to your adventure.

We will continue to improve and modify existing content and adjust new content based on your feedback.
Please continue to provide us your honest thoughts and feedback to make Aeruta the best game possible!

notes.title: Play Test Scheduled for Aeruta’s Fall Update Through Steam Playtest!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!
This is the Aeruta Team.

Thank you for always supporting Aeruta.

As of today, the Steam Playtest has officially begun!

During the Playtest period, all Early Access owners of Aeruta will have the chance to get an early look at the Big Fall Update.
We really wanted to do this as an expression of gratitude for all of your amazing support until now, so we’d be very grateful if you took the chance to play!

At this time, we’re still in the process of developing the final version of the update, so we apologize in advance for any inconveniences caused by performance issues or errors during gameplay.

Check below for further details.

==========================
◆ Duration
Friday, November 8th 2024 (7:00AM PT) to Sunday, November 10th 2024 (until 7:00PM PT!)

◆	Target Group
Users who have purchased the Early Access version of Aeruta

◆	How to Participate
① Right click Aeruta in your Steam library
② From “Properties...” select “Betas”
③ In the “Private Betas” section enter the following code: bakerypreopen202411
④ Click “Check Code”
⑤ Click “Opt into: ea_playtest – for Playtest 241108”
⑥ Aeruta [ea_playtest] will appear in your Library

◆	 Regarding Save Data
While you will be able to pick up from your Early Access save data in the Steam Playtest, please be aware that progress made in the Steam Playtest will not be transferred when the finalized Big Fall Update is implemented.

◆	Steam Play Test Contents
・Addition of the second island, the next stage of Chaya’s missions
・Addition of mastery skills for the whip and rolling pin, be even stronger than before!
・Addition of new stages to challenge you during your adventure
・New powerful enemies added to the dungeons
・New friends to meet in Bakersfield
・Addition of a gift giving feature as well as friendship events
・Research even more unique and tasty breads
・Friends can now assist Chaya in running the bakery
・Further development of the bakery and facilities for an even more lively Bakersfield
・Addition of new minigames

◆ Disclaimer
・Those who purchase the Early Access version of Aeruta during the test play period will be eligible.
・The duration of this test may be changed or cancelled without prior notice due to various reasons.
・This is a version of the game currently under development and does not guarantee the most comfortable version of the gaming experience.
・During test play, unexpected behaviors or issues may occur for which we do not provide support.
・If there are any serious issues or adjustments that need to be made, we may update the software during the test play period.

◆ Survey Participation
We would like to kindly ask everyone who participates in the test play period to fill out a survey.
There are only a few days left until the update, but we would greatly appreciate your cooperation in making Aeruta an even better game!
*The user survey will be made available during the test play period.

Access the survey 
here

==========================

If you have any suggestions or feedback, we would appreciate it if you shared with us through the survey above or on Aeruta’s official X account below.

To everyone considering live streaming or posting videos on video platforms, here’s a quick note!
For Aeruta, there are no specific restrictions on either live streaming or video uploads for both this test version and the full release version. Please feel free to enjoy and share your experience with your viewers and followers!

Just a small request: since this test version may differ from the final release in some aspects, it would be greatly appreciated if you could note this in the video description or somewhere visible.
(Example: “This stream is based on the Steam Playtest version.”)

Once again, we would like to express our sincere thanks to all of you who have supported us so far. We are currently adding the final touches to fully implement the update, so please stay tuned!

Thank you for reading until the end, we hope that you’ll continue to support Aeruta.

notes.title: Aeruta Early Access Ver. 0.1.3 Update Announcement!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

Thank you for enjoying the Early Access version of Aeruta. We are very grateful for the many opinions and requests you have sent us. Based on your feedback, we have updated the game to version 0.1.3.

■ Patch Notes for 2024/07/04
Game System Adjustments

 The game file has been updated to a 64-bit file and the minimum system requirements have been reduced.

New Game Features

The altar in front of the bakery starts to glow with the aroma of delicious bread! By using the accumulated "Bread Energy" created from running the bakery, you can obtain a variety of effects to help you in your adventure.
The Water Song obstacle course mini-game can be replayed by interacting with the trophy displayed in your room!
A side quest has been added for Chiva. This will allow you to start training earlier than before. If the save data you've been playing has already past the timing for the quest to occur, the quest will be added to your save data automatically.
Added a vibration setting to the controller, it will shake or not shake depending on your preference!
New outfits for villagers have been added, and more outfits planned for the future! Stay tuned!
Added more villager conversation variations, a hint will be indicated for conversations that have not been read yet.
Drop rate for boss materials have been increased (hooray!!)
Skills with cooldown will now be displayed with a numerical value representing the cool down speed.
Monster shadows are now only displayed on the ground the same as Chaya.
More hints are now indicated for when a quest or conversation is available.
Timer reduces when the wrong direction is input during checkout.
Total amount of damage inflicted is now shown below the combo display. This display can be turned off from the Settings menu by selecting "Show Damage Figures".
Text size increased in most UI since it was difficult to see on the Steam Deck.
Adjustments to the camera perspective at Merca Shrine.


Battle Adjustments

The Water Pillar attack has been adjusted to have flashier effects!
The stopping effect of a successful evasion has been improved.
When monsters attack they fall to the ground quickly rather than staying suspended in the air.
Skill activation and bread-eating actions are no longer interruptible.
 Increased the amount of dough gained when the weapon skill: Bear's Wrath is used.
Increased recovery amount for all breads (hooray!)
The damage, cooldown, and level-up effect values of some skills has been changed. Some skill's damage and other effects are enhanced when leveling up.
 The effect of the weapon skill: Fearless Assault has been revised so that the lower the HP, the more damage dealt (so strong!)


Bug Fixes

notes.title: Aeruta Early Access Ver 0.1.2 & Demo Version Update Announcement!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

Thank you for enjoying the early access version of Aeruta. We also appreciate the many opinions and requests you have sent us. Based on your feedback, we have updated it to version 0.1.2.

This update primarily focuses on improving the early game experience and balancing the casual mode. In addition to updating the early access version, we've also updated the demo as well! In the demo update, we added save and transfer features and adjusted the game balance and localization to match the early access version.

■ Patch Notes for 2024/05/29
Game Balance and System Adjustments

 Adjusted the skill tree screen to allow resetting acquired skills using coins.
 Added a preview function for each skill in the skill tree screen.
 Adjusted the ability to manually save by examining the bed in Chaya's room (very convenient!).
 Enhanced the effects when performing construction in Bakersfield.
 Adjusted the timing for unlocking the Knight's Base upgrade in Bakersfield.
 Adjusted the timing for unlocking recipe upgrades.
 Overall adjustments to the amount of coins and wood required for construction.
 Changed Bollio's bill amount from 1250 coins to 999 coins.
 Increased the material drop rate from the tutorial boss "Elite Stabby Crab".
 Adjusted to allow obtaining a special trophy by scoring 300 points in the Watersong Festival mini-game.
 Adjusted so that the long-range attack disappears when a long-range attacking monster has been defeated.
 Added an effect above Chaya's head when the cooldown after dashing is complete.
 Adjusted to allow dashing within the village (faster!).
 Added key assignments for opening the bag with key bindings.
 Adjusted the key assignment settings to allow assigning keys to operation buttons using key bindings.
 Removed the description text for the skill tree at the Knight's Base in the construction screen.
 Adjusted the explanation text for the status enhancement "Luck" to make it easier to understand.

Battle Adjustments

 Adjusted to reduce the damage taken from monsters when they are knocked back.
 Further reduced the damage reduction rate in casual mode.
 Adjusted the damage dealt to monsters in casual mode.
 Adjusted the calculation process for damage received in casual mode.
 Adjusted the strength variation range of monsters.
 Adjusted the durability of some monsters.
 Adjusted the falling motion of Shooty Crab’s bullets.
 Adjusted the hit range of some techniques of the Rock Golem.
 Shortened the cooldown for aerial dashes (stronger!).

Bug Fixes

 Fixed a bug where an unintended screen would open at the end of the Watersong Festival mini-game.
 Fixed a bug where the effect of "Bollio's Construction" level 1 was not functioning in the construction screen.
 Fixed a bug where some monsters would stop fighting (no more pacifist monsters).
 Fixed a bug where "Patti King" unintentionally buffed itself.
 Fixed a bug where the character image displayed in the date change effect would not update until the game was restarted.
 Fixed a bug where the display related to recipe upgrades would be distorted under certain conditions.
 Fixed a bug where villagers could be interacted with while on moving platforms in the square.
 Fixed a bug where the effect of "Skill: Protective Strike" would not trigger under certain conditions.
 Fixed a bug where Effie would pretend to be busy even after the store closed.
 Fixed a bug where the settings "Screen Shake," "Display Damage," and "Display Buffs on Characters" were defaulted to off at initial startup.
 Fixed a bug where assigning keys to the mouse in key bindings would render operations impossible.
 Fixed a bug where the Summer Clam pulled by the whip drive would penetrate short platforms.
 Fixed a bug where the display would become distorted when opening and closing multiple UI's simultaneously.
 Fixed several localization-related bugs.


Finally, we would like to express our deepest gratitude to everyone supporting Aeruta. During the Early Access period, we will be improving and adjusting existing content and new content based on your feedback. We welcome your honest opinions.

We hope you'll continue to support to make Aeruta the best game possible!

Game Design & System Adjustments

 Added options in system settings to toggle screen shake, damage numbers, and buff displays above characters' heads.
 Added a tutorial for crossing platforms in the tutorial stage.
 Increased the overall size of the checkout mini-game interface.
 Improved the description of enhancement choices in the skill tree interface.
 Changed the description of luck in ability training, but the effect remains the same.
 The script for the Watersong mini-game now clearly states that the perfect score is 300.
 The gold trophy standard for the Watersong mini-game has been changed to 280, and the perfect score will be indicated in another way in the future.
 Adjusted the description of label bonuses in the daily interface.
 Adjusted the text size of daily ability bonuses in the calendar interface.
 The date in the upper right corner now indicates the season.
 The experience numbers in the development interface are now clearer.
 You can now exit key bindings using the cancel key.

 Villagers now make a sound when you achieve great success at checkout.

 Improved the stun ability of the martial Weapon Skill: Rolling Pin Cyclone.
 Reduced the tenacity of the Shooty Crab, its bullets now only bounce once, and the hitbox size has been reduced.
 Lowered the volume of the bullet hell attack used by the boss in 1-1.
 Reduced the natural anger increase rate of the boss in 1-3 and the increase rate when hitting Chaya, and also lowered the frequency of consecutive melee attacks (she should be a mage!).
 Adjusted some translation content.

Bug Fixes

 Fixed the issue where crab monsters sometimes abandoned combat during battle (they were too peaceful!).
 Fixed the issue where "did not eat any bread" appeared during adventure settlement before unlocking takeaway bread.
 Fixed the issue where the cursor moved to the far right in a short time when entering the adventure stage selection interface while moving.
 Fixed the issue where opening the backpack after selecting a stage in the adventure stage selection interface caused the game to freeze.
 Fixed the issue where bread received bonuses before unlocking the calendar.
 Fixed the issue where dropped items stick to ceilings or walls.
 Fixed the issue where lines in the bread list in the adventure preparation interface deepened over time.
 Fixed the issue where Effie could get stuck in the crafting animation during bread discount periods.
 Fixed the issue where customers complained about the lack of bread during bread discount periods.
 Fixed the issue where villagers got stuck in walking animation at the start of bakery events.
 Fixed the issue where the bonus numbers in parentheses were higher than the actual numbers in the management settlement interface.
 Fixed the issue where the bear claw attack range of the martial Weapon Skill: Bear's Wrath was larger than it appeared.
 Fixed the issue where damage reduction in easy mode also reduced healing.
 Fixed the issue where there was no sound when changing weapons in the skill tree interface.
 Fixed the issue where loading a save on the day the calendar was unlocked caused strange cutscenes.
 Fixed the issue where the dialogue box shifted when walking near Bollio while he was talking in town.
 Fixed the issue where starting a conversation from his left side in the Bollio debt repayment scenario caused the camera to shift and Bollio to face the wrong way.
 Fixed the issue where villagers' shadows remained after they disappeared in the scenario where villagers ask for help in 1-2.
 Fixed the issue where the dialogue for starting and finishing construction was reversed in Glass's construction interface.
 Fixed the issue where Patty King’s animation froze after turning around during the first encounter.
 Fixed the issue where task requirements still showed "pass through Leafy Path" when passing through Leafy Path on the day it was unlocked.
 Fixed the issue where there was no sound when selecting the chat button.
 Fixed the issue where the label color for Pedori bread ability: Spicy Tongue was incorrect.

 Fixed the issue where elite stage items in the Stone Corridor showed as Giant Hammer Rock.


Finally, we would like to express our deepest gratitude to everyone supporting "Aeruta". During the Early Access period, we will be improving and adjusting existing content and new content based on your feedback. We welcome your honest opinions.
